pre RepairExists:
    Repair.allInstances()->exists(r | r.Id = rid)

pre StaffExists:
    Staff.allInstances()->exists(s | s.Id = sid)

post NewApprovalHistoryCreated:
    result.oclIsNew()

post ApprovalHistoryRecordsDecision:
    result.StaffId = sid and
    result.Reject = reject and
    result.Suggestion = suggestion

post ApprovalHistoryLinkedToRepair:
    let repair : Repair = Repair.allInstances()->any(r | r.Id = rid) in
        repair.History = repair.History@pre->including(result)

post RejectTrueRole1AdvancesProcess:
    let repair : Repair = Repair.allInstances()->any(r | r.Id = rid) in
    let staff : Staff = Staff.allInstances()->any(s | s.Id = sid) in
        reject = true and staff.Role = 1 and repair.Process@pre = 0
        implies
        repair.Process = 1

post RejectTrueRole2AdvancesProcess:
    let repair : Repair = Repair.allInstances()->any(r | r.Id = rid) in
    let staff : Staff = Staff.allInstances()->any(s | s.Id = sid) in
        reject = true and staff.Role = 2 and repair.Process@pre = 1

        repair.Process = 2

post RejectFalseSetsRejectedStage:
    let repair : Repair = Repair.allInstances()->any(r | r.Id = rid) in

        repair.Process = 5

pre BookExists:
    Book.allInstances()->exists(b: Book | b.CallNo = callNo)

pre NoCopyWithSuppliedBarcodeForBook:
    Book.allInstances()->any(b: Book | b.CallNo = callNo)
        .Copys->forAll(c: BookCopy | c.Barcode <> barcode)

    BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(c: BookCopy |
        not BookCopy.allInstances()@pre->includes(c) and
        c.Barcode = barcode and
        c.Location = location and
        c.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE and
        c.IsReserved = false
    )

post NewBookCopyLinkedToBook:
    let b: Book = Book.allInstances()->any(book: Book | book.CallNo = callNo) in
    let c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(copy: BookCopy |
        not BookCopy.allInstances()@pre->includes(copy) and
        copy.Barcode = barcode
    ) in
        c.BookBelongs = b and
        b.Copys->includes(c)

post CopyCountIncreased:

        b.CopyNum = b.CopyNum@pre + 1

        c.Barcode = barcode and
        c.Location = location and

context LibraryManagementSystemSystem::renewBook(uid: String, barcode: String): Boolean

pre UserCopyAndLoanExistAndUserNormal:
    User.allInstances()->exists(u: User |
        u.UserID = uid and
        u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and
        BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(c: BookCopy |
            c.Barcode = barcode and
            Loan.allInstances()->exists(l: Loan |
                l.LoanedUser = u and
                l.LoanedCopy = c and
                l.IsReturned = false
            )
        )
    )

pre CopyNotReservedLoanNotOverdueAndDueAfterToday:
    Loan.allInstances()->exists(l: Loan |
        l.LoanedUser.UserID = uid and
        l.LoanedCopy.Barcode = barcode and
        l.IsReturned = false and
        l.LoanedCopy.IsReserved = false and
        l.DueDate > Today and
        l.OverDueFee = 0
    )

pre RenewalLimitSatisfied:
    Loan.allInstances()->forAll(l: Loan |
        l.LoanedUser.UserID = uid and
        l.LoanedCopy.Barcode = barcode and
        l.IsReturned = false implies
            (
                (l.LoanedUser.oclIsKindOf(Student) and l.RenewedTimes < 3) or
                (l.LoanedUser.oclIsKindOf(Faculty) and l.RenewedTimes < 6)
            )
    )

post RenewalUpdated:
    Loan.allInstances()->forAll(l: Loan |
        l.LoanedUser.UserID = uid and
        l.LoanedCopy.Barcode = barcode and
        l.IsReturned = false implies
            l.RenewedTimes = l.RenewedTimes@pre + 1 and
            l.RenewDate = Today
    )

post DueDateExtended:
    Loan.allInstances()->forAll(l: Loan |
        l.LoanedUser.UserID = uid and
        l.LoanedCopy.Barcode = barcode and
        l.IsReturned = false implies
            (
                (
                    l.LoanedUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) and
                    l.LoanedUser.oclAsType(Student).Programme = Programme::BACHELOR and
                    l.DueDate = l.DueDate@pre + 20
                ) or
                (
                    l.LoanedUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) and
                    l.LoanedUser.oclAsType(Student).Programme = Programme::MASTER and
                    l.DueDate = l.DueDate@pre + 40
                ) or
                (
                    l.LoanedUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) and
                    l.LoanedUser.oclAsType(Student).Programme <> Programme::BACHELOR and
                    l.LoanedUser.oclAsType(Student).Programme <> Programme::MASTER and
                    l.DueDate = l.DueDate@pre + 60
                ) or
                (
                    l.LoanedUser.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) and
                    l.DueDate = l.DueDate@pre + 60
                )
            )
    )

post ResultIsTrue:
    result = true
